Timeline item

Source: R/v2-timeline.R
shad_timeline_item.Rd

Timeline item

Usage

shad_timeline_item(
  title,
  ...,
  time = NULL,
  description = NULL,
  icon = NULL,
  status = c("default", "active", "muted"),
  last = FALSE,
  class = NULL
)

Arguments

title

The item title (string or tags).

...

Additional content appended after the description.

time

Optional timestamp (rendered in a <time> element).

description

Optional description line.

icon

Optional icon inside the dot: a shad_icon() name or a tag. When omitted the dot is a small filled circle.

status

"default", "active" (primary-filled dot), or "muted".

last

If TRUE, omit the trailing connector (auto for the final child; set explicitly if composing dynamically).

class

Extra CSS classes.

Value

A timeline item <li> tag.

See also

Other shadshiny dashboard: shad_chart_container(), shad_timeline(), shad_value_box()
